accounting.meaning: A_dependence is the in-sample reduction in squared one-step error from the spatial ML fit and its neighbour-conditional predictor; it is not an LMG share, not a variance component and not a mechanism, and it is never added to any named group. full_sample.interval_note: asymptotic, conditional on W and the Gaussian model; not spatially robust
